responsibility: Defines the rustc_infer error diagnostics module’s catalog of inference-related diagnostic data types, subdiagnostics, and suggestion builders used to report type, trait, coercion, lifetime, and pattern-matching inference failures with structured spans, labels, notes, and fix-it suggestions.
same_name_distinction: Unlike the other `mod.rs` files here, this module does not run inference, solve constraints, or choose when to emit diagnostics. Its code is primarily `#[derive(Diagnostic)]` and `#[derive(Subdiagnostic)]` definitions, suggestion enums, and payload structs that reporters in `error_reporting/infer/mod.rs` and `traits/error_reporting/mod.rs` populate and emit.
